applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Small Finance Banks – Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy) Sixth Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: Small finance banks must apply the revised 2 per cent risk weight to trade exposures to QCCPs for clearing member activities.
answer.action_quote: a risk weight of 2 per cent shall be applied to the bank’s trade exposure to the QCCP in respect of OTC derivatives transactions

effective_date.quote: These Amendment Directions shall come into effect from the date of issue.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (Small Finance Banks - Prudential Norms on Capital Adequacy) Directions, 2025
